questions.question: When was the Doctrine of Sequential Suspension articulated by the asset?
questions.explanation: The Doctrine of Sequential Suspension was articulated by the asset on 19 June 2022 in the aftermath of the Mendoza Pyrrhic engagement.

questions.question: What is the maximum number of activations per 60-second window according to the Three-Two-One Rule?
questions.explanation: The Three-Two-One Rule states that the maximum number of activations per 60-second window is three.

questions.question: What is required for Tier 5 threat engagement?
choices: B) Cell operation with lead authority
C) Cell + auxiliary cell with Director's authorization
D) Solo operation with full authority
questions.correct_answer: C) Cell + auxiliary cell with Director's authorization
questions.explanation: For Tier 5 threats, engagement requires Cell + auxiliary cell with Director's authorization.
questions.user_answer: B) Cell operation with lead authority

questions.question: What is the result of the Tail-Strike Technique?
choices: A) A strike delivered at reduced velocity
B) A strike delivered at full thrown velocity but from an arbitrary location
C) A strike delivered with increased momentum
D) A strike delivered with reduced momentum
questions.correct_answer: B) A strike delivered at full thrown velocity but from an arbitrary location
questions.explanation: The Tail-Strike Technique delivers a strike at full thrown velocity but from an arbitrary, target-adjacent location.
questions.user_answer: B) A strike delivered at full thrown velocity but from an arbitrary location

questions.question: How many activations are allowed before reset according to the Doctrine of Sequential Suspension?
questions.explanation: The Doctrine of Sequential Suspension states that the asset should withdraw before exhaustion, with three activations and reset.
